pr_title: CSM: Avoid circular dependency in camera computations.
pr_body:
Fixed #25246.

**Description**

CSM computations in `CSM.update` used `light.shadow.camera` `position` and `orientation`, but those were set during the rendering based on `light.position` (see `LightShadow.updateMatrices`), which itself was set later in the `CSM.update`. This led to a kind of chicken and egg problem, as a result the shadows in the first frame rendered ever or after significant camera orientation change had some shadows missing because of improper bounding boxes computed for the shadow frustums.

The PR avoids the circular dependency, using `lightDirection` to compute the transformation matrix directly.

issue_context.title: CSM not rendered properly in the first frame
issue_context.body:
### Description

When you run the _webgl_shadowmap_csm_ example, the first frame is missing some shadows (one or more near cascades).

I guess some update of a camera or a light is missing in `CSM.update`.

### Reproduction steps

1. to make the issue obvious. open _webgl_shadowmap_csm.html_ source and replace `requestAnimationFrame( animate )` with `setTimeout(() => requestAnimationFrame( animate ), 2000)` or remove it completely, so that you can see the first frame
2. run _webgl_shadowmap_csm.html_
3. notice near shadows are missing


### Code

Use the example code `webgl_shadowmap_csm.html`

### Live example

Use https://threejs.org/examples/webgl_shadowmap_csm, but to better see the issue modify the source as described

### Screenshots

This is how the first frame looks like:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6927223/211010590-a977fda7-e31d-4321-b29a-04b9611808b5.png)

And this is the correct result, shown on sucessive frames:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6927223/211010806-89ff8716-6ca5-4ea5-950d-1c0b0ae1009e.png)


### Version

r148

### Device

Desktop

### Browser

Chrome

### OS

Windows

review_comments: That is the chicken-egg problem. Light position and quaternion are not set yet, they will be set later in this function based on the frustum bounding box.
